record.paper_title: AUTOMORPHISMS AND DYNAMICS: A LIST OF OPEN PROBLEMS
record.context_brief: Zariski closures of automorphism actions on Calabi–Yau varieties
record.original_question: Fix an integer d ≥ 2. For a Calabi–Yau variety X of dimension d, let G^0(X) denote the neutral component of the Zariski closure of the discrete cohomological action Aut(X)^* inside GL(H^2(X; R)). Which linear algebraic groups can occur as G^0(X) when X ranges over all Calabi–Yau varieties of dimension d?

evidence.quote: Question 2.7. Fix a dimension d ≥ 2. Define G0(X) as the neutral component of the Zariski closure of Aut(X)∗ in GL(H2(X; R)). What kind of linear algebraic groups G0(X) do we obtain in this way, when X runs over all possible Calabi-Yau varieties of dimension d ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $d \geq 2$ be an integer. A Calabi–Yau variety of dimension $d$ is a smooth, simply connected, projective complex variety $X$ of dimension $d$ with trivial canonical bundle $K_X \cong \mathcal{O}_X$ and $H^0(X, \Omega_X^p) = 0$ for $0 < p < d$. Let $\mathrm{Aut}(X)$ denote its group of biregular automorphisms, and let
$$\mathrm{Aut}(X)^* \subset \mathrm{GL}(H^2(X;\mathbb{R}))$$
denote the image of the natural representation of $\mathrm{Aut}(X)$ on the second real cohomology of $X$. Let $\overline{\mathrm{Aut}(X)^*}^{\mathrm{Zar}}$ be the Zariski closure of $\mathrm{Aut}(X)^*$ in $\mathrm{GL}(H^2(X;\mathbb{R}))$, viewed as a real linear algebraic group, and define
$$G^0(X) := \left(\overline{\mathrm{Aut}(X)^*}^{\mathrm{Zar}}\right)^0$$
to be its neutral (connected) component.

Determine, or characterize as completely as possible, which real linear algebraic groups arise as $G^0(X)$ when $X$ ranges over all Calabi–Yau varieties of dimension $d$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open question in a list of open problems on automorphisms and dynamics. A targeted web search did not turn up any paper providing a classification of the neutral component of the Zariski closure of the cohomological automorphism action on Calabi–Yau varieties of arbitrary dimension d ≥ 2. The question appears to remain open.

status_evidence.snippet: List of open problems on automorphisms and dynamics, including the question on G^0(X) for Calabi–Yau varieties.
status_evidence.claim: The question is posed as an open problem in a problem list, with no resolution announced.

status_evidence.title: Movable cone and automorphisms of Calabi–Yau threefolds (related literature)
status_evidence.snippet: Studies of automorphism and movable cones of specific Calabi–Yau threefolds; no general classification of G^0(X) is given.
status_evidence.claim: Related results address specific cases but not the general classification.
